import sys

class AK375:
    def ak375(self, n, s):
        buffer1 = []
        buffer2 = []
        max_length = 0
        nested_count = 0

        i = 0
        while i < n:
            c = s[i]
            if c == '(':
                buffer2.append('_')
                j = i + 1
                while j < n and s[j] != ')':
                    buffer2.append(s[j])
                    j += 1
                i = j  # skip to position after ')'
            elif c == ')':
                buffer1.append('_')
            else:
                buffer1.append(c)
            i += 1

        parts2 = ''.join(buffer2).split('_')
        list2 = [part for part in parts2 if part]
        count2 = len(list2)

        parts1 = ''.join(buffer1).split('_')
        for part in parts1:
            if len(part) > max_length:
                max_length = len(part)

        return f"{max_length} {count2}"

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input_lines):
        n = int(input_lines[index])
        index += 1
        s = input_lines[index]
        index += 1
        result = AK375().ak375(n, s)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
